ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: This is a food web of a habitat. This habitat is threatened by developers, who will remove three-quarters of the grass in the feeding areas of mice and rabbits. Under this change, what change is most likely to occur in the hawk population?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: The number of hawks will decrease

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: This is a food web of a habitat. This habitat is threatened by developers, who will remove three-quarters of the grass in the feeding areas of mice and rabbits. Under this change, what change is most likely to occur in the hawk population?
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: The number of hawks will decrease
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture shows a food web, and the arrows indicate energy pointing from food to predators. Grass is at the bottom, with arrows pointing to the mouse, rabbit, and grasshopper; the mouse has an arrow leading to the hawk, the rabbit is also connected to the hawk through paths such as the snake, and the snake also has an arrow leading to the hawk. Then reason: The question stem says that developers will remove three-fourths of the grass in the feeding areas of the mouse and rabbit, which will greatly reduce the food of the mouse and rabbit, so the numbers of mice and rabbits are most likely to decrease. The hawk depends on these animals or food chains supported by them to obtain energy; fewer prey will reduce the food available to the hawk, so the hawk population is most likely to decrease.
